sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can describe healthy and unhealthy habits and say how much I exercise and sleep.
I can say what someone should do using kellene and ask what I should do in a situation.
I can say I do one thing instead of another, and give advice to someone else with azt javaslom/tanácsolom, hogy.
I can say what I am and am not able to do with tud, and what is or isn't allowed with lehet.
I can compare habits and say how I'm changing them from now on.
